[INTERCOM to Okafor] I’m opening the bay. Hold position until I confirm the doors are fully open. I’m monitoring your oxygen supply.
[SHIP SYSTEMS] Seal the inner bay hatch, depressurize the shuttle bay, and open the outer doors as soon as pressure is safe. Activate docking guidance.
[INTERCOM to Okafor] Follow the docking guidance once the doors are fully open.
